title: Bean Hive Roast Development Time Ratio
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beanhive:roast
eval dev_ratio=development_sec/roast_min
where dev_ratio<0.15 OR dev_ratio>0.25
description: Checks Bean Hive roast development time ratio bounds.
value: Surfacing bean hive roast development time ratio helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant kitchen, cooking & fermentation export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It treats when bean hive roast development time ratio matters for your routine.
